definitions.explanation: Feeling self-conscious or uncomfortable due to a situation. Can describe both the feeling of embarrassment and situations that cause it.
Feeling reluctant to do something in front of others due to self-consciousness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧{恥|は}ずかしい。
examples.english: I made a mistake and I'm embarrassed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧{恥|は}ずかしかったです。
examples.english: My face turned red and I was embarrassed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{恥|は}ずかしかったです。
examples.english: I fell in the train and was very embarrassed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からなくて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧{恥|は}ずかしかったです。
examples.english: When the teacher called my name, I didn't know the answer and was embarrassed.

examples.japanese: {恥|は}ずかしい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{言|い}えません→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I can't say it because I'm embarrassed.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恥|は}ずかしいです。
examples.english: Speaking in front of everyone is embarrassing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{恥|は}ずかしくて⟦{話|はな}せません→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm too shy to talk in front of people I'm meeting for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧じゃ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{恥|は}ずかしいです。⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けます→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: Since my Japanese isn't good yet, I'm shy about talking with Japanese people. But I'll keep studying.

notes:
{恥|は}ずかしい is an i-adjective meaning 'embarrassed,' 'ashamed,' or 'shy.'

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {恥|は}ずかしく
- Noun form: {恥|は}ずかしさ (embarrassment)
- Te-form: {恥|は}ずかしくて

USAGE NOTE:
Like many Japanese feeling adjectives, {恥|は}ずかしい can describe:
- The person feeling embarrassed: {恥|は}ずかしかった (I was embarrassed)
- The situation causing embarrassment: それは{恥|は}ずかしい (That's embarrassing)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜するのは{恥|は}ずかしい: It's embarrassing to do ~
- {恥|は}ずかしくて〜できない: Too embarrassed to ~
- {恥|は}ずかしがる: to act shy, to be bashful

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {恥|はじ}: shame (noun)
- {恥|はじ}をかく: to be shamed/embarrassed
- {恥|は}ずかしがり{屋|や}: shy person
